name: BN4's net areas in BN6's net
now: Its five large areas (groups 0x90-0x94, BN4_GROUP_*) dress BN6's as BN5's do, in players' runs by the seed since 5 November 2026 (run_dress, each over the BN6 area it is like in half the runs; the owner's call 10, docs/multirom/bn4.md, Turned on, whole; shipped in 0.20.0), held out of runs and shown to a dev tool's review alone before that (xarea_review: --net-biome x15-x19 and the atlas still show each alone). Its net maps are 256-colour (the tile map header's +2, BN6_TILEMAP_COLOURS, 1 as in BN6's real world; no 16-colour packing fits BN6's banks), so the map reader draws them so and BN6's BG1 and BG2 are set 256-colour in RenderInfo (eToolkit +8, its BG controls at +4, BN6_BGCNT_NET_BG1 0x3D03 and BG2 0x3E02 on the net) while such a layer shows: its tiles to 0xCE00 lie below BN6's chat box's at 0xD100. Its backdrops' 9-word records are copied as BN6's 7 and its LoadBGAnim found as EnterMapGroup's fifth call (game state at +0x40). Seen in the game: each area's floor, backdrop and battle background whole, the chat box as on any layer; runs, BN5's areas and a run reading BN4 for its families the same frame for frame as before.
left: Their battles and bystanders BN4's (BN6's for now; their guardians are BN4's nine in half the runs since 12 November 2026, docs/game/bosses/bn4-navis.md); a BN4 song copied whole carries its drum kit's 219 KB (the keys played alone, the music's work); which country is which of 0x93's maps; Black Earth's maps (0x94:6-7) not drawn; Town Area's holed fields drawn as lattices.
